command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes' -Method Get).name; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes' -Method Get).name; `$nodes=`$a | Where-Object {`$b -contains `$_}; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){foreach(`$c in @('display current-configuration','show running-config')){`$ec=[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$ec; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$ec; `$o1=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1 -Method Get).output; `$o2=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2 -Method Get).output; if(`$o1 -notlike 'Error:*' -and `$o2 -notlike 'Error:*'){`$d=Compare-Object (`$o1 -split '\r?\n') (`$o2 -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object {`$_.InputObject -match 'stp|route|cost|shutdown|address|vrrp|track|bgp|ospf|isis|mpls|mtu|nat |acl|policy|prefix|vlan|bpdu|hrp|security|loop|interface|traffic|bandwidth|ip binding' -and `$_.InputObject -notmatch 'Last configuration|certificate|engineid|no ip address|ip http|source-interface|server-source|source all-interface|mop|sysid'}; if(`$d){Write-Output ('=== '+`$n+' :: '+`$c+' ==='); `$d | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 300}; break}}}"
